messages:
zoe: starting a short thread: onboarding v5-lite (quant-fused) into canary. want a clear versioning + gate plan for A/B and auto-fallback.
marc: agree. we need deterministic rules: metric thresholds, min sample counts, cohort weight, and cooldowns. keep auto-fallback conservative.
riyad: primary failure mode observed in earlier runs: semantic drop on instruction-follow extraction and ordering. propose combined metric rule (semantic_f1 and ordering_accuracy) + distribution shift check.
zoe: sketch gate: if semantic_f1 delta_pct <= -3% AND ordering_accuracy delta_pct <= -2% AND JS-divergence > 0.07 -> consider auto-fallback. require min_samples 1200 per slice and slice_weight >= 2%. require 2 consecutive windows (5m).
marc: add safety: do not auto-fallback if latency_p95 improved by >10ms. also require bootstrap CI where lower bound crosses threshold. add cooldown 2h after manual promote.
riyad: include versioning note: label variant as v5-lite-quant-fused, pin model_lease id in canary metadata, and auto-tag commit hash. ensure rollouts record model lineage for audit.
zoe: draft YAML to add to canary repo: 
```yaml
gate:
  name: v5-lite-semantic-ordering-gate
  windows: 2
  metrics:
    - name: semantic_f1
      comparator: delta_pct
      threshold: -3.0
      min_samples: 1200
    - name: ordering_accuracy
      comparator: delta_pct
      threshold: -2.0
      min_samples: 1200
    - name: JS-token
      comparator: delta
      threshold: 0.07
  cohort_filter:
    slices: ["extract/order","instruct/extract"]
    min_traffic_pct: 2
  safety:
    require_bootstrap_ci: true
    require_latency_check: true
    latency_metric: p95
    latency_margin_ms: 10
  action:
    on_violation: auto_fallback
    notify: ["#oncall","#eng-ml"]
    manual_override_cooldown: 2h
    record_versioning: true
```
marc: looks solid. also add a behavioral check: topk disagreement > 15% for the slice to bias toward manual review instead of auto-fallback.
riyad: good call. add microshadow step: on gate fail, schedule microshadow replay with longer kv-ttl to disambiguate warmup vs model error. if microshadow recovers >70% -> convert auto_fallback to staged_pause and create ops ticket.
ops-bot: deploybot: canary shadow started 4422223340 region-us-west for v5-lite-quant-fused
eval-bot: eval-bot: window1 results: semantic_f1 delta -3.6% (95% CI [-4.5,-2.7]), ordering_accuracy -2.3%, JS-token 0.08, topk_disagreement 12%, affected slice weight 2.3%
zoe: CI crosses thresholds and JS-token flagged. topk disagreement below behavioral cutoff so auto-fallback should proceed per gate. tagging @marc @riyad for manual confirmation.
marc: since behavioral check not triggered, gate will auto-fallback after window2 confirm. waiting for window2.
eval-bot: eval-bot: window2 results: semantic_f1 delta -3.9% (95% CI [-4.8,-3.0]), ordering_accuracy -2.6%, JS-token 0.09
zoe: two windows confirm -> auto-fallback executed. ops-bot: rollback enacted and ticket created 4422223340-rollback.
riyad: scheduling microshadow replay tonight with kv-ttl=120s and 50k samples to investigate warmup. recording model lineage and canary config in the audit log.
marc: will follow up with postmortem and a proposed mitigation (kv-ttl bump + minor recalibration) if microshadow indicates warmup.
